name: bitlink-invoices
description: Create, list, and inspect Bitlink payment invoices from Cursor via MCP. Each request forwards the merchant Bearer token to the Bitlink REST API; the plugin never stores a shared API key.

BITLINK_MCP_URL.title: MCP server URL
BITLINK_MCP_URL.description: Absolute URL of the running Bitlink invoices MCP endpoint. Local default: http://127.0.0.1:3000/mcp

BITLINK_API_TOKEN.title: Merchant API token
BITLINK_API_TOKEN.description: Sanctum Bearer token for the authenticated merchant. Forwarded as Authorization on every MCP request.
